title: Parallel-agent tooling: CPU isolation for latency runs + tracker fragments

Check experiments/2026-11-13-cpu-isolation: p50/p95 0.335/0.645 ms timing alone, 0.501/0.661 ms with background load, 0.659/1.126 ms (max 16 ms) no isolation. Soak processes unpinned (0xFFFF), not changed. Tracker fragments: wiki/progress/fragments/<task-id>.json merged by build.js (tools/progress/fragments.js, self-check test-fragments.js, README). How-to: compute-setup.md section CPU isolation; HANDOFF rules.
